scope: Diagnostic textured blocks with actual SI motion, fixed orthographic cameras, no realistic scene/contact/noise. Flow is renderer correspondence with occlusion screening, not an estimated optical-flow score.

input_contract.deployment: Uncontrolled or static real video must expose uncertainty; absolute modulus is not guaranteed identifiable.

detail: 真实 SI 轨迹渲染 32/32；未放大 RGB、遮挡筛选对应光流、同材质坐标纹理。

quasistatic_identifiability.scope: Settled displacement only. Transient dynamics may differ at fixed density. This does not prove impossibility for calibrated dynamic videos.

occlusion_scope: Paired image-space occluders with visibility masks. No 3D hand, gripper contact or friction simulation yet.
